certifications.name: UL Listed
certifications.description: Product tested and certified to UL safety standards.

certifications.name: CE Marked
certifications.description: Product bears the CE mark, indicating conformity with applicable EU health, safety, and environmental protection legislation.

standards.name: IEC 61496-2
standards.description: Safety of machinery — Electro-sensitive protective equipment — particular requirements for equipment using active opto-electronic protective devices (AOPDs), such as safety light curtains.

products.name: Aurora BX54 Fiber Laser Engraver
products.description: Fiber laser engraving system for marking and cutting metal, plastic, and other hard materials. Rated for continuous shop-floor use.

products.name: BX54 Fume Extraction Filter Cartridge
products.description: Replacement filter cartridge for the BX54 fume extraction attachment. Captures particulate and odor generated when engraving/burning material.

products.name: Veridian GL100 Safety Interlock Switch
products.description: Guard-locking safety interlock switch for hinged and sliding guard doors. Positive-opening contacts and a coded actuator resist defeat, for use on access points where machine energy must be isolated before entry.

products.name: Veridian ES200 Emergency Stop Pushbutton
products.description: Panel-mount emergency stop pushbutton with a latching mushroom head and positive-break contacts for machine safety circuits. Also available as a pull-wire e-stop for perimeter guarding of conveyors and long machine lines.

products.name: Veridian LC900 Type 4 Safety Light Curtain
products.description: Type 4 safety light curtain for point-of-operation guarding on presses and automated cells. Muting and blanking configurable per zone, with resolution options down to finger detection for close-proximity hazards.

products.name: BX54 Replacement Focus Lens
products.description: OEM replacement focus lens for the BX54 fiber laser engraver. Lenses degrade with prolonged use and should be inspected regularly for pitting or haze.
